svg.title: Proxy
svg.desc: Proxy. Stand in for another object with the same interface to control access to it: lazy loading, caching, access checks, remoting. Step 1, Load everything up front: GalleryPage creates 20 FullPhotos and each reads 12 MB: 240 MB before first paint, for one photo. Step 2, A stand-in, same interface: PhotoProxy implements Photo but keeps only a file name: 20 proxies, 0 MB, and GalleryPage unchanged. Step 3, Load on first use: Opening #7: the proxy creates FullPhoto (12 MB) and forwards display(); opening it again reuses it. Step 4, Other proxies, same shape: ProtectedPhoto refuses bob before anything is forwarded; remote and caching proxies share the shape.

g.text: GalleryPage creates 20 FullPhotos and each reads 12 MB: 240 MB before first paint, for one photo.
PhotoProxy implements Photo but keeps only a file name: 20 proxies, 0 MB, and GalleryPage unchanged.
Opening #7: the proxy creates FullPhoto (12 MB) and forwards display(); opening it again reuses it.
ProtectedPhoto refuses bob before anything is forwarded; remote and caching proxies share the shape.

228 of those MB hold 19 photos that the user never opens
→ the only line that changed: 0 MB up front
real is already set, so nothing is loaded

Caching proxy keeps results and answers repeat calls itself
